paper.title_en: Mechanical angular momentum loss at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ from static and radiative gravitons
paper.abstract_en: We determine the loss of mechanical angular momentum $L^μ_{\rm loss}$ of two gravitationally scattering bodies at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ using worldline quantum field theory (WQFT). The gravitational memory effect, a phenomenon of the early- and late-time behaviour of the gravitational field, leads to static contributions to $L^μ_{\rm loss}$. We illuminate how these arise: the linear memory contributes through so-called static correlators, while the nonlinear memory vanishes at this order due to symmetry considerations. The computation of the remaining, dynamical part resembles that of the $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ impulse. We generate its integrand using a reformulation of the WQFT Feynman rules that conserves four-momentum at every vertex and plainly exhibits the classical loops. The three-loop integrals are reduced to master integrals, whose differential equations and boundary matching in the post-Newtonian limit we describe in some detail. In contrast to conservative effects at this order, only polylogarithms appear. While individual contributions to the dynamical part are divergent, these cancel in $L^μ_{\rm loss}$. The quadratic-in-radiation part of our result reproduces earlier results, while the complete result agrees with existing post-Newtonian results.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在O(G^4)阶用世界线量子场论计算两体引力散射的机械角动量损失，明确讨论引力记忆效应的线性与非线性贡献，涉及三圈积分约简与微分方程求解，理论深度与方法细节较丰富；属于广义相对论基础与引力波物理交叉方向，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 来自静态与辐射引力子的 $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ 阶机械角动量损失
decision.abstract_zh: 我们使用世界线量子场论（WQFT）确定两个引力散射体在 $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ 阶的机械角动量损失 $L^\mu_{\rm loss}$。引力记忆效应——引力场早期和晚期行为的一种现象——导致对 $L^\mu_{\rm loss}$ 的静态贡献。我们阐明这些贡献是如何产生的：线性记忆通过所谓的静态关联子贡献，而非线性记忆在此阶由于对称性考虑而消失。对其余动力学部分的计算类似于 $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$ 阶冲量的计算。我们使用一种重新表述的 WQFT 费曼规则生成其被积函数，该规则在每个顶点上保持四动量守恒，并清晰地显示经典圈图。三圈积分被约化为主积分，我们较详细地描述了其微分方程以及在 post-Newtonian 极限下的边界匹配。与这一阶的保守效应形成对比，这里只出现多重对数函数。虽然对动力学部分的各个贡献是发散的，但它们在 $L^\mu_{\rm loss}$ 中相互抵消。我们结果中辐射的二次部分重现了先前的结果，而完整结果与已有的 post-Newtonian 结果一致。
